headline: Week’s Best: Wells Fargo’s Recruiting Comeback
summary: In their wake, the bank’s wealth management unit suffered an exodus of financial advisors.  Wedding-related spending has increased 8.5% year over year so far in 2026, according to Bank of America payments data.  Inflation is playing a role, but so is social media: A majority of respondents to a BofA survey said the era of digital connections and scrolling has introduced additional expenses, such as hiring content creators to capture and share the special day.

headline: Morton Salt completes jumbo, $3.2B leveraged loan backing sponsor dividend
summary: Morton Salt has completed its $3.2 billion, five-year covenant-lite term loan B at S+275, with a 0% floor and an OID of 99.5 through a Morgan Stanley-led arranger group, according to sources. The TLB priced at the tight end of talk, with a $200 million upsizing, in a shift from a concurrent offering of senior unsecured notes. headline: Morgan Stanley's Dividend Analysis
summary: This article first appeared on GuruFocus.  Morgan Stanley (NYSE:MS) recently announced a total dividend of $1.15 per share, with the ex-dividend date set for 2026-07-31.  This includes a $1.15 per share cash dividend payable on 2026-08-14.
